
{{alias}}( value )
    Tests if an input value is a text mark encoding.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: any
        Value to test.

    Returns
    -------
    bool: boolean
        Boolean indicating if an input value is a text mark encoding.

    Examples
    --------
    > var o = { 'field': 'label' };
    > var v = new {{alias:@stdlib/plot/vega/value/ctor}}( o );
    > o = { 'text': v };
    > v = new {{alias:@stdlib/plot/vega/mark/text/encoding-set}}( o );
    > o = { 'update': v };
    > v = new {{alias:@stdlib/plot/vega/mark/text/encoding}}( o );
    > var bool = {{alias}}( v )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}( {} )
    false

    See Also
    --------
